about_the_game:
Super Novice – A small class with a big heart that will bring you freshness, flexibility, and challenges once again in the world of Legendary Heroes Survival.

This special character can use a variety of weapons with unique features like no other, including a playstyle that can be changed in many ways, suitable for creative players who love flexibility and novelty.

Whether you want to be a mage, swordsman, archer… or all in one, Super Novice is the answer!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G5400 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / Nvidia GeForce 710 / AMD Radeon HD 6450
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 6000 / Nvidia GeForce 720 / AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Super Novice is a special class that can choose a variety of starting weapons. Suitable for players who like challenges and flexibility in playing.
